description: Generate a built-in parametric template: bracket, pipe, gear, enclosure, or bolt. To revise a previously generated model, pass its modelId and expectedRevision to regenerate it in place. Omit modelId only when the user wants a separate new model.

color.description: Color for a new model, or optional replacement color when regenerating

expectedRevision.description: Current revision from load_model; rejects stale edits instead of overwriting them

modelId.description: Existing model to regenerate in place; omit only to create a new model

name.description: Name for a new model, or optional replacement name when regenerating

name: generate_model
title: Generate CAD model
